clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, the Encrypted Sigil carries a summons to newly awakened night elf rogues. Frahun Shadewhisper calls them to begin training as dangers gather around Teldrassil.

New night elf scouts and infiltrators in Shadowglen receive the Encrypted Sigil through discreet means. A quiet messenger delivers it on behalf of Frahun Shadewhisper. Its contents are hidden instructions that tell the initiate to report to Frahun near Aldrassil. Reading and delivering the token shows Frahun that an initiate can follow subtle directions and handle covert messages.

Frahun uses the summons to explain why rogues matter in an unsettled world. Tensions simmer between the night elves and the distant Horde, but open warfare is not the only danger facing their people. Rogues must gather intelligence across Teldrassil as the Kaldorei’s unseen eyes and blades, and learn to strike before threats take root in the World Tree’s boughs.
